scenarioExecution.definition: Scenarios with a recorded result (passed/failed/partial/blocked) ÷ scenarios planned in this mission.

scenarioCompletion.definition: Scenarios with a conclusive pass/fail ÷ scenarios planned (blocked and partial excluded).

requirementsCoverage.definition: Recorded requirements with ≥1 attempted scenario ÷ requirements recorded from stated sources.

requirementsPlanned.definition: Recorded requirements with ≥1 planned scenario ÷ requirements recorded.

requirementsWithFailures.definition: Requirements with ≥1 failed scenario ÷ requirements recorded.

endpointCoverage.definition: Registered endpoints (from docs/network/supplied) that received ≥1 investigator request ÷ endpoints registered. Says nothing about depth.

scenarios.title: Empty username+password shows Required for both fields without network call
scenarios.observation: Both fields show 'Required'; no network request sent.

scenarios.title: Only username filled shows Required on password only
Valid login reaches dashboard
scenarios.blockedReason: Login submits POST /auth/validate; mission is read-only (allowStateChanging=false) and no credentials were provided as secrets.

scenarios.title: Invalid credentials show error message (server submission)
scenarios.blockedReason: Requires POST submission to /auth/validate, not permitted in read-only scope.

scenarios.title: Rapid double-click on Login with empty fields does not fire requests
scenarios.observation: 3 rapid clicks with invalid form: no submission requests. Rapid-click on a valid form not tested (would POST).

scenarios.title: Protected page /dashboard/index redirects unauthenticated user to login
REST API v2 endpoints return 401 JSON without session
scenarios.observation: 401 body says 'Session expired' for a client with no session.

scenarios.title: Error responses for unknown API routes are consistent JSON and leak nothing
scenarios.observation: Empty text/html 404 for unknown API path; no stack trace leaked.

scenarios.title: Security headers on HTML and API responses (clickjacking, HSTS, version disclosure, cookie flags)
scenarios.observation: No X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors; server version disclosed; HSTS missing on API. Session cookie is Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax (good).

scenarios.title: CORS: foreign Origin not reflected
scenarios.observation: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin for foreign Origin; OPTIONS 405.

scenarios.title: Forgot password link navigates to reset page; Cancel returns to login
scenarios.observation: Mouse navigation works; keyboard reachability fails (see S14).

scenarios.title: Reset with empty username shows Required
Submit reset request for a username
scenarios.blockedReason: Reset request is a POST that may trigger emails/state change; not permitted in read-only scope.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only user can reach every interactive control incl. Forgot password
scenarios.observation: 'Forgot your password?' absent from tab order and not an <a>/<button>. A keyboard Enter-activation attempt crashed the investigator connection; result based on focus-order capture and DOM verification.

scenarios.title: Fields have accessible names; page has lang, h1; social icon links named
scenarios.observation: Inputs placeholder-only, html lang missing, no h1, icon links unnamed, Required errors not exposed via aria-invalid.

scenarios.title: Login page responsive at mobile width 375px (no overflow)
Login page behaviour when i18n messages API fails (500)
scenarios.observation: Raw i18n keys rendered and uncaught 'AxiosError: fe' when i18n API returns 500.
